name: Stillness in Timber
description: Stillness in Timber finds beauty in the unhurried — a residential interior designed around white ash joinery, white oak surfaces and a philosophy of wabi-sabi restraint. The design embraces imperfection, natural texture and quiet materiality over decoration. Modular kitchen, bespoke wardrobes, layered bedroom suites and a dedicated study — each space considered not for how it looks, but for how it feels to live in.
